Hi Lina / VaultPay team,

Thanks again for taking the demo today — good discussion on throughput and data isolation requirements. Per our call, summarizing the immediate security artifacts and items you asked for so your procurement and security teams can move forward: 

- High-level items we will share: SOC 2 Type II report (latest), list of subprocessors (cloud infra + managed services), data residency options and KMS integrations.
- Security questionnaire: I see you mentioned an initial vendor questionnaire. If you can share the questionnaire PDF, we’ll map answers back and surface any open items.
- Data boundaries / flows: we’ll provide a short doc showing what metadata and PII (if any) is sent to Redwood hosted endpoints vs kept in-customer VPC for Private deployments.

Next steps / timeline:
1) Lina — if you can drop the questionnaire by end of day, I’ll get Monica + Grace to draft answers within 48 hours.
2) Monica — can you pull the most recent SOC2 and subprocessor inventory and confirm redactions we can share publicly?
3) Grace — please prepare a one-page data flow diagram for hosted vs private.

Attachment: demo_recording_link (I’ll add to the Drive once uploaded).

Happy to hop on a follow-up call with your security team if needed.

Thanks,
Rishi

Thanks Rishi — great walkthrough. Attached is our standard vendor security questionnaire (VaultPay_Vendor_Sec_Q_v3.pdf). A few clarifying items from our side: 

- Our information security team will need answers to the questionnaire fields related to encryption at rest/in transit, key management, incident response SLAs, and subcontractor list.
- We require either a SOC 2 Type II report or a completed bridge letter if the latest report predates 12 months.
- For GDPR processing, we need the subprocessor list and any data transfer mechanisms to third countries (Standard Contractual Clauses, EU adequacy, etc.).

Can you confirm whether Redwood’s hosted API ever persists full customer prompt text to third-party analytics vendors? We need a short statement for procurement.

If possible, please provide the items requested by EOD Monday so we can keep our procurement window open.

Lina Ortega
Senior Security Program Manager, VaultPay
security@vaultpay.com

Rishi — pulling items now. Quick notes: 

- SOC 2: We have the 2025-09 SOC 2 Type II report cleared for external sharing (redactions: internal IP tables). Filename attached: 2025-09-SOC2-report.pdf.
- Subprocessor inventory: canonical export attached: subprocessor_inventory_20260216.csv. It includes cloud providers (GCP us-west1 / AWS eu-west-1 for Dedicated fallbacks), monitoring (Datadog), error/telemetry sinks (Sentry) and a managed logging partner (Logkeep). For each entry we included 'access level' and 'data categories' columns.
- Hosted prompt persistence: short answer below for procurement: "Redwood's hosted API may temporarily cache request tokens and prefixes to optimize latency; we do not forward full customer prompt text to third-party analytics providers by default. Any telemetry sent to third parties is aggregated and pseudonymized; customers can opt-out or choose Private deployment to fully isolate data."
- GDPR / cross-border: we have SCCs available and a data transfer FAQ; I’ll link to the page and include a copy if they need it.

Attachments: 2025-09-SOC2-report.pdf, subprocessor_inventory_20260216.csv, kms-integration-notes.txt

Next steps: I will assemble a cover email addressing Lina’s questionnaire sections 3–7 and flag any items for product that require architectural confirmation (few edge cases around KV cache duration). Grace, can you finish the one-page data flow by EOD Friday PST?

Monica Patel
